transcript:
Speaker A (AI): Hello, where are you right now?
Speaker B (Human): I'm at my home.
Speaker A (AI): Priya, tell me about your family.
Speaker B (Human): I'm having one brother and one sister.
Speaker A (AI): "I am having" nahi, "I have one brother and one sister" hota hai. "Having" tab lagate hain jab kuch abhi ho raha ho, jaise "I am having tea". Brother tea nahi hai jo abhi ho raha hai. [Not "I am having", it is "I have one brother and one sister". "Having" is used when something is happening right now, like "I am having tea". A brother is not tea that is happening right now.]
Speaker B (Human): Haan haan, okay okay. I have one brother and one sister. [Yes yes, okay okay. I have one brother and one sister.]
Speaker A (AI): Good. Ab batao, kal kya kiya tumne? [Good. Now tell me, what did you do yesterday?]
Speaker B (Human): Yesterday, I didn't went to college.
Speaker A (AI): "Didn't went" nahi hota, "didn't go" hota hai. Jab "didn't" laga diya toh baad mein simple form aayega: go, eat, sleep. "Didn't went" matlab tumne past tense do baar laga diya. [It's not "didn't went", it's "didn't go". When you use "didn't", the simple form follows: go, eat, sleep. "Didn't went" means you used the past tense twice.]
Speaker B (Human): Are yaar, ye toh basic hai aur mujhe ye bhi nahi aata. Class mein sab English mein baat karte hain, main chup rehti hoon. [Oh man, this is basic and I don't even know this. Everyone in class speaks in English, I stay quiet.]
Speaker A (AI): Chup isliye rehti ho kyunki darr lagta hai galat bol dogi toh koi hasega, hai na? [You stay quiet because you're afraid that if you speak incorrectly, someone will laugh, right?]
Speaker B (Human): Haan, ek baar canteen mein friend ne pucha "What did you eat?", maine bola "I eated rice". Sab hase, tab se muh nahi kholti. [Yes, once in the canteen a friend asked "What did you eat?", I said "I eated rice". Everyone laughed, since then I don't open my mouth.]
Speaker A (AI): "Eated" nahi hota, "I ate rice" hota hai. "Eat" ka past tense "ate" hai, irregular verb hai. Par tumhari galti nahi hai, school mein rules rataye the, samjhaye nahi the. Isliye English Seekho app banaya gaya hai. Expert ke chhote-chhote video hain, Hindi mein samjhate hain. 2-5 minute ke lessons, bilkul aise hi jaise main samjha rahi hoon. Aur main hoon AI coach, 24 ghante available. Roz expert se seekho, mere saath aake practice karo. Tumse 500 baar galti karwaungi, har baar sudharungi. Kabhi nahi bolungi "itna bhi nahi aata". [It's not "eated", it's "I ate rice". The past tense of "eat" is "ate", it's an irregular verb. But it's not your fault, in school they made you memorize rules, they didn't explain them. That's why the English Seekho app was made. There are short videos by experts explaining in Hindi. 2-5 minute lessons, just like I am explaining. And I am your AI coach, available 24 hours. Learn from experts daily, come practice with me. I'll let you make mistakes 500 times and correct you every time. I'll never say "you don't even know this much".]
Speaker B (Human): Lekin time kahan hai yaar? College, tuition, ghar ka kaam... [But where is the time? College, tuition, housework...]
Speaker A (AI): Roz sirf 15-20 minute, jitna time ek reel dekhne mein jata hai. Ek mahine mein farq dikhne lagega. Aur trial sirf ek rupaye ka hai, canteen ki chai se bhi sasta. Install ka button dabao aur English Seekho app download karo. Ek mahine baad jab canteen mein confidently bolo "I ate rice", tab samajh aayega asli farq. Aur jo hase te na, wahi puchenge "teri English achhi kaise ho gayi?". [Just 15-20 minutes daily, the same time it takes to watch a reel. You'll see a difference in a month. And the trial is only 1 rupee, cheaper than canteen tea. Press the install button and download the English Seekho app. A month later when you confidently say "I ate rice" in the canteen, you'll understand the real difference. And those who laughed will ask "how did your English get so good?".]
Speaker C (Voiceover): Toh install button par click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
